description.en: Unstyled, accessible React component primitives with adaptive interactions by Adobe.
description.zh: Adobe 出品的无样式 React 原语库，提供高等级无障碍支持与跨设备交互行为。

content.en: React Aria is a comprehensive library of unstyled, accessible UI primitives and React hooks developed by Adobe. Built to power scalable design systems, it packages WAI-ARIA compliance, complex keyboard navigation, touch and pointer normalization, internationalization in over 30 languages, and robust state management across more than 50 components. By abstracting accessibility and device quirks without prescribing visual styling, it leaves styling completely to Tailwind, CSS Modules, or custom tokens.
content.zh: React Aria 是由 Adobe 打造的无样式（Headless）React 组件原语与底层 Hook 工具库。专为企业级设计系统与复杂应用架构而生，全面覆盖 50 多个基础组件的 WAI-ARIA 规范合规、精细键盘导航、触屏与鼠标自适应交互、30 多种语言的国际化与 RTL 支持，以及严谨的状态管理逻辑。它彻底解耦了组件行为逻辑与视觉排版，将外观样式完全交由 Tailwind、CSS Modules 或自定义设计规范实现。
